title: Choose a safer visual world
question: Safer register: three conventional directions plus the category standard. Pick one, or re-roll again.

options.label: Annual Report
options.thesis: The studio presented as a credible company: clean white plates, navy ink, and a quiet grid a procurement officer trusts.
options.viewport: A clean hero with headline and primary action, three service tiles, three portfolio items, contact CTA. No decoration beyond the grid.
options.risk: Reads as every other agency site; safe, but indistinguishable without the craft.
options.case: Familiar register: the conventional end of the candidate list.

options.label: Studio Letter
options.thesis: A letter from the studio: warm cream paper, charcoal ink, a single amber accent, and serif headlines that read like a memo.
options.viewport: A letter-style hero with the offer as a headline, a short paragraph, and a contact line; services and portfolio as simple lists below.
options.risk: Reads as a blog or newsletter if the letter metaphor is not carried through.
options.case: Familiar register: warm and readable, low risk.

options.label: Spec Sheet
options.thesis: A specification sheet: white ground, black ink, one accent, and a swiss grid that reads like documentation.
options.viewport: A spec-sheet hero: title, version line, contents table, and a contact action. Dense, precise, no ornament.
options.risk: Reads as documentation, not a persuasive site, if the action is buried.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably: a clean grid, real product photography, and a visitor who knows exactly where to click.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft: hero, three services, three portfolio items, CTA.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
